If still open, independently reproduce #2977 symbolic-versus-exported parity on the tiny duplicate fixture, compare the selected unique-row positive control, and define either enforced uniqueness or consistent multiplicity semantics. A bounded guard-adoption patch must preserve valid inputs and test the actual exported action. Stop after this obligation; no full historical replay or frontier change follows from the mutant alone.
